title: BG not rounded with dynISF
symptom: After few days with dynisf, in nightscout BG is 'float' and not rounded. With dynisf off situation is normal with rounded values.
cause: The issue is attributed to xdrip, as stated by the maintainer: 'it's xdrip issue'.
fix: The maintainer added rounding of incoming values in a commit: 'i added rounding of inccoming values anyway https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/3e681ef219ceb11b6a185548ef735c8e43bd97ea'.
evidence_quote:
it's xdrip issue
